entities.name: Jón Ögmundsson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jón Ögmundsson or Ögmundarson, also known as John of Hólar and St. Jón Ögmundarson or Ögmundsson, was an Icelandic Catholic bishop. In 1106, the second Icelandic diocese, Hólar, was created in the north of Iceland, and Jón was appointed its first bishop. He served as bishop there until his death.
